question: I'm interested in joining the club. How do I join?
answer: It's simple! To join the club, you'll need the Zoom link for our club meetings. To receive the link, contact us and let us know you're interested in joining. We'll guide you from there! You can also visit Ms. O'Donnell's room (E204) and speak with her directly.

question: Is there a charge to join?
answer: No! The club is completely free of charge. We hope this simple service will benefit you!

question: What will I gain from joining this club?
answer: We hope the club will help you improve your writing and storytelling skills. It's also a great opportunity to have your work heard by more experienced writers and learn from their experience!

question: When are the club meetings?
answer: Our club meetings are held every Thursday from 3:30 PM to 4:00 PM EST.

question: Do I need to be a club member to submit my story?
answer: No! We encourage everyone to share their writing potential with the world. Please make sure to read our submission guidelines before sending us your story!

question: Do I need to be a CHS student to publish a story or join the club?
answer: At the moment, yes. Since this is a Christiana High School writing club, only CHS students are eligible to join. Please note that this rule may change in the future.

question: How old do I need to be to join the club?
answer: You must be in 9th through 12th grade to join the club.

question: I've sent a message but haven't received a response. Did I do something wrong?
answer: Most likely not! If you've submitted an inquiry through the contact form on the Novice Ink. website, please allow up to one week for a response. Our club members may be busy, so we appreciate your patience. If your inquiry is urgent, feel free to send a follow-up email.

question: How do I report a glitch, malfunction, or error on the website?
answer: If you encounter any issues with the website, such as mobile compatibility problems, typos, or information not loading properly, please let us know through our contact form. Be sure to describe the issue and title your message "Website Issue" or something similar so we can address it as soon as possible. Your feedback is important to us!

question: How and where do I submit my story?
answer: First, read through our story submission guidelines to ensure your story meets school standards and is appropriate for publication. Next, complete the permissions form, labeled "Form" on the home page, before beginning the submission process. This ensures we have your permission regarding specific aspects of the process. Once you've completed these steps, you're ready to upload your story! Navigate to the genre that best matches your story, scroll to the bottom of the page, and you'll find the submission form. The remaining steps should be self-explanatory!

question: Why is my account disabled?
answer: Novice Ink. takes respect among its members very seriously. If we discover that you're violating our terms despite our clearly stated rules, we'll send you a warning email. If you disregard this warning, Novice Ink. reserves the right to disable your account after a certain period. If the negative behavior continues even after your account has been re-enabled, your account will be deleted, and your email address will be recorded to prevent you from using the website again. However, if you believe your account was disabled by mistake, please contact Novice Ink.'s programmer, Hairum, at hairumq@noviceinkwritersclub.com.

question: Why is my account deleted?
answer: Your account was most likely deleted because you disregarded a warning email and continued engaging in negative behavior even after your account was re-enabled. If you believe this was a mistake, please contact Novice Ink.'s programmer, Hairum, at hairumq@noviceinkwritersclub.com. Please note that once an account is deleted, it cannot be recovered. Account deletion is generally a last-resort measure for members who repeatedly fail to respect our guidelines and rules. Your account will not be deleted without a legitimate reason. If an account is accidentally deleted, Novice Ink. will contact the affected member, explain what happened, and provide them with their data.

question: Do I need writing experience to join the club?
answer: Not at all! Whether you're passionate about writing, write frequently, or only write occasionally, you don't need much experience to join the club.
